mostWorthwhile.text: Putting insulin with the muscle fibres was most worthwhile: it showed glucose becoming stored carbohydrate while insulin acted as a message, not a building material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing the second hormone felt somewhat repetitive after releasing insulin, though it set up the different liver route.

surprise.text: The liver store could supply glucose back to the blood between meals, while the muscle stored glucose for its own work.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the pictures and labels explained both hormone pairings and their destinations.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter offered a new question to figure out. The two fuel routes were clear, but their labelled pairings left little to puzzle over.
